term: a single God witness with uniqueness and classical attributes
definition: UniqueClassicalGodExists σ means ∃g, σ.IsGod g ∧ IsTheOneGod σ.IsGod g ∧ σ.HasClassicalAttributes g. Every conjunct concerns the same g. IsTheOneGod quantifies over all beings satisfying the original σ.IsGod, not only maximal beings.
note: Logical packaging for composition of the existing Stage1, Stage2 and skeleton results. No source claim or naming converse is added; all component meanings remain the existing definitions. The explicit uniqueness conjunct lets the existing skeleton consume the witness without conflating separate existential witnesses.
